question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
Here the correct answer is Carved.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in **blank number 3** is **"carved"**.
 
• The phrase **"Deo erexit Voltaire" **means **"Voltaire erected this to God"**, and it refers to the inscription on the facade of the church that Voltaire renovated. Therefore, it is most likely that Voltaire had the inscription carved onto the facade.
 
• The verb **"carved"** refers to the act of cutting or chiseling an object or material to create a particular shape or design. It is often used in reference to carving wood or stone to create decorative objects or sculptures.
 
 
• Example: The sculptor **carved **a beautiful statue out of marble.
